judgement_by: Hon. K.T. Chithrasiri, J. and Hon. Sisira de Abrew, J.
keywords: No co-owner left out during transfer of land, and all had agreed to a clearly separated and defined parcel of land alienated to the predecessor in title of Respondents from the larger land. Held - Petitioner entitled to obtain declaration of title without partition action; such transferee does not become a co-owner of the larger land. Appeal allowed with costs dismissing District Court judgement dismissing the Petitioner’s application for declaration of title.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
